scripts.title: Nice
scripts.script:
local library = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bloodball/-back-ups-for-libs/main/wall%20v3')))()

local w = library:CreateWindow("A") 
local b = w:CreateFolder("B") 

local items = {}

for i, v in pairs(workspace.RuntimeItems:GetChildren()) do 
    table.insert(items, v.Name)
end 

local SelectedItemName 
local itemDropdown = b:Dropdown("Spawned Items", items, true, function(selectedItem)
    SelectedItemName = selectedItem
end)

local function refreshDropdown()
    items = {} 
    for i, v in pairs(workspace.RuntimeItems:GetChildren()) do 
        table.insert(items, v.Name)
    end
    itemDropdown:Refresh(items) 
end

workspace.RuntimeItems.ChildAdded:Connect(refreshDropdown)
workspace.RuntimeItems.ChildRemoved:Connect(refreshDropdown)

b:Button("Bring Item", function()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local character = player.Character
    local SelectedItem = workspace.RuntimeItems:FindFirstChild(SelectedItemName)

    if SelectedItem and SelectedItem.PrimaryPart and character and character.PrimaryPart then
        local hrp = character.PrimaryPart 
        local forwardOffset = hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 5 
        SelectedItem.PrimaryPart.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + forwardOffset
        task.wait(.1)
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Drag"):WaitForChild("RequestStartDrag"):FireServer(SelectedItem)
    else
        print("Nigger")
    end
end)

local myLabel = b:Label("Fuel Value", {
    TextSize = 25;
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
    BgColor = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 38);
})

b:Button("Check Item Fuel Value", function()
    if SelectedItemName then
        local SelectedItem = workspace.RuntimeItems:FindFirstChild(SelectedItemName)
        if SelectedItem and SelectedItem:GetAttribute("Fuel") then 
            myLabel:Refresh("Fuel: " .. tostring(SelectedItem:GetAttribute("Fuel")))
        else 
            myLabel:Refresh("Item Has No Fuel")
        end
    else
        myLabel:Refresh("No Item Selected")
    end
end)

b:Button("Honk Train", function()
    workspace.Train.TrainControls.Lever.HitBox.ClickDetector.ActivationDistance = math.huge
    fireclickdetector(workspace.Train.TrainControls.Lever.HitBox.ClickDetector)
end)
-- Item must be held
b:Button("Put Item In Fuel", function()
    firetouchinterest(workspace.RuntimeItems:FindFirstChild(SelectedItemName).PrimaryPart, workspace.Train.TrainControls.FuelDetect, 0)
    firetouchinterest(workspace.RuntimeItems:FindFirstChild(SelectedItemName).PrimaryPart, workspace.Train.TrainControls.FuelDetect, 1)
end)

scripts.title: Micro Hub
scripts.features:
## Core ESP Features

### Item ESP
- **Boxes**: Draw outlines around items for better visibility
- **Names**: Display item names for quick identification
- **Distance**: Show exact distance to each item
- **Tracers**: Connect lines from player to items for easy tracking
- **Highlights**: Make items visible through walls with customizable highlight color

### ESP Customization
- Fully customizable ESP colors with color pickers
- Adjustable transparency settings
- Multiple tracer styles (Normal, Pulse, Rainbow)
- Configurable tracer origins (Bottom, Center, Mouse)
- Adjustable text size and font
- Toggle individual ESP components on/off

## Advanced Visualization Tools

### Item List
- Displays nearby items in a compact UI panel
- Customizable maximum items shown
- Distance-based sorting
- Adjustable maximum detection distance
- Configurable view angle for item detection
- Color customization for background, borders, and text
- Adjustable update interval for performance optimization
- Repositionable UI (left/right screen)

### Minimap System
- Real-time overhead view of surrounding area
- Shows player position and orientation
- Displays items within configurable range
- Adjustable size and zoom level
- Optional rotation with player movement
- Customizable colors for player and items
- Optional distance rings for range estimation
- Repositionable (corners of screen)
- Optional item labels on minimap

## User Interface
- Clean, modern UI design using Obsidian Library
- Tabbed interface for organized settings
- Keybind support for quick ESP toggling
- Save/load configuration system
- Theme manager with customizable UI colors
- Help tooltips for settings

## Technical Features
- Efficient rendering system for minimal performance impact
- Auto-detection of new items as they spawn
- Proper cleanup when unloading to prevent memory leaks
- Frame-rate independent updating
- Supports multiple game folders/containers

## Support
- Discord community access for updates and support
- Regular updates and improvements
- Compatible with most modern Roblox exploits
